subject: PO token mapping, milestone release triggers, and weekly consolidated invoice request
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@capitalhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marc Santos <marc.santos@capitalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 4672 - weekly invoicing + milestone releases

Hi Grace,

Quick question from procurement as we're preparing the PO for your SOW: our AP team needs Redwood to accept a single master PO (PO #4672) but invoice on a weekly consolidated cadence tied to milestone release events. Two items we need clarified before we attach the PO to our ERP: 

- PO header mapping: we need the vendor system to accept our po_id token in the invoice header and echo the po_id on each invoice line. Can Redwood map a custom header (po_id) to the invoice metadata?
- Net terms: our standard is net90 for this finance cohort. Will Redwood accept net90 on a master PO, or does that require additional approvals?
- Milestone releases: we will trigger deliverable-based releases (small weekly releases). We need invoices to be emitted only on release confirmation — is there a way to gate invoices to the release event so we don't get duplicate charge windows?
- Remittance and VAT: please confirm the remit address and whether you can include VAT lines on the weekly consolidated invoice.

Attaching our draft PO (CapitalHealth_PO_4672.pdf) and a sample remittance guide.

Appreciate a quick note on feasibility — our ERP cutover is this month and we want to ensure no manual reconciliation.

Best,
Lina Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Capital Health Systems

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@capitalhealth.com>
Cc: Marc Santos <marc.santos@capitalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 4672 - weekly invoicing + milestone releases

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Happy to make this work; summary below and a couple asks so finance/legal can align.

Short answers up front:
- PO header mapping: yes — we can accept a po_id token and surface it on invoice line items. We’ll need the exact ERP field name (po_id or PO_NUMBER) and a sample EDI/XML snippet; mapping usually takes one business day to validate.
- Net terms: net90 is outside our standard hosted terms (net45). We can approve net90 as a customer-specific exception but it requires a signed preauthorization and finance approval (one-time credit check).
- Milestone-gated invoicing: we support release-gated billing. We can configure a weekly consolidated invoice that only issues when a release event is recorded. We'll need your release webhook or the confirmed release-report (CSV) each week.
- VAT / remit: we can include separate VAT lines and set the remit address to match the PO — confirm whether remittance should go to Redwood Inference US (AP remits to ap-us@redwoodinference.com) or the EU entity.

Proposed path to production: 
1) We validate PO header mapping with a sample (please send the XML extract).
2) Capital Health signs the preauth form (I attached a short preauth_form.pdf) so finance can run the credit check.
3) We enable a weekly consolidated invoice lane tied to your release CSV / webhook. Billing will only emit when the release is confirmed; otherwise nothing is invoiced.
4) If net90 is approved by finance, we’ll note a bespoke term on each invoice and add an accounting tag to your account. Expect a 3–5 business day review.

I’ve attached a short plan (week_invoice_plan.xlsx) that shows invoice timing and examples. If you’re ok with the preauth + the release CSV, I’ll loop in our finance lead for the credit review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Lina Park <lina.park@capitalhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marc Santos <marc.santos@capitalhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 4672 - weekly invoicing + milestone releases

Thanks, Grace — that flow works for us. A couple clarifications before we sign the preauth: 

- ERP field: our system exposes PO_NUMBER in the invoice XML; we can provide a sample XML extract by EOD.
- Release webhook: we prefer to provide a signed weekly CSV (SFTP drop) rather than an external webhook; does Redwood support SFTP ingestion?
- VAT: Capital Health will be VAT-exempt on US invoices; please include a VAT_exempt flag on the invoice metadata so our AP can auto-route.

If you can accept SFTP drops for the release file and confirm PO_NUMBER mapping and VAT_exempt metadata, we’ll sign the preauth today and initiate the credit cohort review.

Appreciate it,
Lina

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Fw: PO 4672 - weekly invoicing + milestone releases (approval request)

Team — looping you both for a quick exception decision and implementation notes. Summary of customer asks: 

- Capital Health (D-78321) needs a master PO accepted (PO_NUMBER = PO 4672) with weekly consolidated invoices gated to release events (they will provide weekly CSVs via SFTP).
- They want the invoice to echo PO_NUMBER on each line and have a VAT_exempt flag set for US invoices.
- They asked for net90 terms. Grace’s recommendation: approve net90 as a finance exception contingent on a signed preauth (attached) and a standard credit review. Implementation notes: 
  - Engineering can map PO_NUMBER from the incoming XML/SFTP and tag invoice metadata; requires a one-day mapping task.
  - Billing can enable a release-gated consolidated lane; ensure idempotency (if release CSV retries, invoices should not duplicate).

Questions for approval: 
1) Vanessa — from a commercial perspective, are we comfortable offering net90 conditioned on the preauth and credit check? We may want to require a signed commitment for the first 2 months to mitigate risk.
2) Karthik — finance: can you confirm the credit-review SLA and whether we need a PO holdback or deposit to enable net90 for this new account?

Attachments: CapitalHealth_PO_4672.pdf, preauth_form.pdf, week_invoice_plan.xlsx

If you want, I can set up a 15-minute triage with Capital Health and finance this week.

Thanks,
Grace
